description: A help article with expandable details (detail only, no why).

nodes.text: If you've forgotten your password, you can reset it using your email address.
1. Click 'Forgot password' on the login page
2. Enter your email address and click 'Send reset link'
3. Check your email and click the reset link

expandable.detail: The reset link is valid for 24 hours. If you don't see the email, check your spam folder.
